name: Fantasy Expo
blurb: A Hungarian fan convention in Budapest for fantasy, sci-fi, anime, manga and comics fans, built around its cosplay competition and artist alley.
notes: The site's only dated edition was 'Nyári Fantasy Expo' (Summer Fantasy Expo), held 2026-08-29 at ELTE Gömb Aula, Budapest — already over before the 2026-10-05 research window starts. News coverage (port.hu, playdome.hu) refers to past 'Nyári' (summer) and 'Téli' (winter) editions, suggesting this may run more than once a year, but neither the English nor Hungarian homepage names a next date as of 2026-10-05, so editions is left empty rather than guessed. Organizer left blank: the ticket contact address (info@supernovaevents.hu) and a 'Supernova' logo appear on the page, but neither page states who legally organizes the event.
